articles.title: Figma jumps as AI push boosts software design spending
articles.mainIdea: Figma jumps as AI push boosts software design spending
articles.summary: Reuters: Figma jumps as AI push boosts software design spending. Shares of Figma rose around 14% before the bell on Thursday as investors cheered ‌the software design provider's strong revenue forecasts and ‌commentary around its artificial intelligence ambitions. Figma has become a popular choice ​for design among diverse groups, including enterprises and freelancers, as it allows users to execute every step of the creative process - from ideation and brainstorming to coding and shipping - ‌on a single platform. To ⁠grow its foothold in a highly competitive market, Figma has embedded AI into its platform ⁠to attract more users - a strategy also employed by larger rival Adobe, as they tussle for customer dollars. Related tickers mentioned: FIG.
